details: Working with python this time to build high performance simulation software for beamforming software.
Working with CUDA to accelerate the simulation software in real-time.

Owned the design, delivery, and production operations of Java and Go microservices for the Fully Charged EV platform, supporting roughly 12,000 charging sessions/month with 99.9% uptime and reliable customer experience.

Worked closely with business stakeholders and operational teams to understand customer use cases, translate requirements into backend capabilities, and improve product adoption across charging workflows.
Served as a frontline technical resource for charger integrations by implementing and maintaining OCPP 1.6J communication and OCPI roaming flows across multi-vendor environments.
Improved platform performance and customer experience by optimizing PostgreSQL and Redis usage, reducing API latency by about 35% and lowering database load by about 40%.
Strengthened observability and issue resolution through Prometheus, Grafana, structured logging, alerts, runbooks, and postmortems, helping teams detect problems faster and reduce MTTR.

Partnered with engineers and internal stakeholders on safer releases, diagnostics tooling, and CI/CD automation, improving rollout quality, reducing rollback incidents, and documenting operational best practices.

Designed and implemented a Go backend for video storage and streaming serving 100M+ monthly requests, while working closely with customers and internal stakeholders to understand usage patterns, pain points, and feature needs.
Acted as a customer-facing technical partner in a startup environment, helping translate business and client requirements into scalable backend services and stable low-latency playback experiences.
Built and optimized microservices and delivery workflows for reliability, performance, and growth, enabling fault-tolerant content delivery during peak traffic.
Improved customer success and operational visibility by implementing monitoring, alerting, and real-time service metrics that supported faster troubleshooting and data-driven performance tuning.
Collaborated across engineering and product discussions to prioritize fixes, support feature adoption, and improve the end-user experience based on customer feedback and operational trends.
Automated CI/CD and documented technical best practices, enabling faster low-risk releases and improving service stability in production.
Worked directly with customers across multiple client projects to understand business goals, technical requirements, and user pain points, then translated them into mobile product solutions.

Led and contributed to the delivery of high-impact applications across e-commerce, transportation, IoT, and social platforms, balancing customer expectations with technical execution and product quality.
Acted as a trusted technical partner for clients by advising on feature feasibility, implementation tradeoffs, release priorities, and best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
Contributed to customer success by improving app quality, maintainability, and adoption through unit testing, performance optimization, and reliable production delivery.
Worked on applications such as G.Ride, CardoO, Game3at, and Cyne HCPs, supporting real user needs through scalable mobile features, IoT integrations, and SDK development.
Delivered solutions for more than 10 clients, including several high-growth and viral applications, while maintaining strong communication and responsiveness throughout project execution.
Built and maintained Node.js microservices for core business workflows, supporting reliable backend operations and customer-facing subscription and payment experiences.
Integrated Stripe payments end-to-end, including checkout, webhooks, refunds, and recurring billing, while ensuring stable transaction handling and strong customer trust.
Worked with product and frontend teams to understand business requirements, improve API usability, and support smooth feature rollout for customer-facing services.
Improved service reliability and issue resolution by adding structured logging, operational dashboards, and retry-safe webhook processing with idempotency controls.
Optimized backend performance for critical endpoints to stay under 500 ms and contributed to infrastructure improvements that significantly reduced downtime.
Helped modernize a legacy codebase and stabilize payment migration workflows, supporting high availability, safe rollout, and minimal disruption to customers.
Worked directly with clients across multiple freelance projects to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, recommend technical solutions, and deliver applications aligned with business needs.
Built mobile applications using Flutter, Swift, and Kotlin across education, fitness, media, and communications use cases, often serving as the primary technical point of contact.
Helped customers improve product quality and user experience by developing custom features, optimizing native video playback, and adapting third-party integrations for production use.
Contributed to open-source and client-facing tooling, including Flutter video player improvements and Zoom-related integrations, to support more reliable application behavior.
Supported 50+ developers and companies in publishing apps to the App Store and Play Store, guiding them through release requirements and helping reduce review delays.
Built long-term client trust through responsive communication, practical technical guidance, and consistent delivery across diverse project needs.
